schedule.statedIn: Studio rules. Festival windows are those of src/time-context.ts (adapted from upstream dsh-pet/src/host/time-context.ts); meal hours follow its time-of-day slots (morning 7-9, noon 11-13, dusk 17-19); snack hours sit in the afternoon (15-17) and evening (21-23) slots; months assume the northern hemisphere. Upstream draws these clips at random with no schedule.
